intro: Compare the current HONE coaching options, then apply once and let the team match you to the right fit.

services.name: Duo Coaching
services.bestFor: Individual Overwatch players who want mechanics and game sense developed together.
services.support: Mechanics, aim, positioning, decision-making, and one shared development direction.
services.features:
Coordinated feedback from both coaches
VOD and gameplay diagnosis
Mechanics and aim development
Macro and decision-making support

services.name: Pro Team Coaching
services.bestFor: Overwatch teams that want structured development for two player slots.
services.support: Custom benchmarking, coaching software, and two sessions per week for each included player.
services.features:
2 player-development slots
Custom benchmarking
Access to coaching software
2 sessions per week, per player

services.name: Elite Team Coaching
services.bestFor: Larger rosters, Valorant teams, or organizations needing more coached player slots.
services.support: Custom benchmarking, coaching software, and two sessions per week for each included player.
services.features:
5 player-development slots
Custom benchmarking
Access to coaching software
2 sessions per week, per player

faq.question: What happens after I apply?
faq.answer: Your application is saved for the coaching team to review. We usually contact you on Discord within 2 business days to confirm fit, availability, and the next step.

faq.question: Why does Duo Coaching use two coaches?
faq.answer: The duo combines mechanics and aim development with positioning, decision-making, and game sense. Both coaches work from one coordinated direction instead of giving disconnected advice.

faq.question: Do I need a VOD before applying?
faq.answer: No. A VOD or replay link helps the team understand your current play, but it is optional at the application stage.

faq.question: Is a specific rank guaranteed?
faq.answer: No. Coaching provides diagnosis, practice direction, and feedback, but results depend on practice, consistency, and competitive conditions.

faq.question: How do team-coaching slots work?
faq.answer: Each included slot covers one selected player. The Pro package includes two slots and Elite includes five. The team can ask about additional slots before purchasing.

faq.question: What are the cancellation and refund terms?
faq.answer: The written terms supplied for your booking or package apply. Read the Cancellation & Refund Policy before completing payment and contact HONE promptly if plans change.

closingHeading: Still not sure which option fits?
closingText: Submit one application and describe what you want to improve. The coaching team will recommend the most useful path instead of pushing you into the largest package.
